test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can complete a task in 15 days and B can do it in 20 days. What is their one day work together?
solution:
**Given;**

A can complete a task in 15 days.

B can complete a task in 20 days.

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 15 and 20 = 60

Total work = 60 units

Efficiency of A = 60/15 = 4

Efficiency of B = 60/20 = 3

Together A and B work taken time = 60/(4 + 3)

⇒ 60/7

Work done is inversely proportional to time taken.

**∴ Work done together by A and B = 7/60**
